title: Look Up | Model Y L Glass Roof
Olivia Norton of Sanctuary AI discusses the future of dexterous robotics.
summary:
Just in: footage from this year's Humanoid Robot Forum at Automate.

Olivia Norton of Sanctuary AI participated in the “Hands, Manipulation, and the State of Physical AI” panel to discuss the future of dexterous robotics.

Olivia shared Sanctuary AI's perspective on deploying Physical AI where it can deliver value today, starting with existing industrial robotic systems while building toward the next generation of intelligent robots. She also discussed why dexterity remains foundational to solving real-world industrial tasks and enabling broader adoption of Physical AI.

Thank you Brian Heater for moderating and fellow panelists from PSYONIC and Kinisi for a great discussion.
